title: KHR_character_expression_suppression Suppression Properties
description: Defines one multiplicative factor from the containing source expression to a target expression. All factors read one immutable pre-suppression driver vector.

target.description: Index of the native expression driver attenuated by this suppression.
target.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.gltf_detailedDescription: This name is independent of the target expression entry's name; no correspondence is implied or required. Resolution MUST use `target`, not this value.

type.description: Suppression factor type. Standard values are 'blend' and 'block'. 'block' is threshold-triggered attenuation and fully blocks its target only when amount is 1. A custom value is shaped like a glTF vendor extension name and MUST be ignored at runtime unless a supported companion extension object on this suppression, keyed by exactly this value, defines its factor as one finite value in [0, 1].

amount.description: Attenuation amount used by the standard 'blend' and 'block' factors.
amount.gltf_detailedDescription: On a custom type it has no standard meaning, and only the factor of a supported same-object companion extension MAY read it. Such a factor reads an omitted value as `1`, so omitting it gives the same factor as authoring `1`.

threshold.description: Strict source-driver threshold for a standard 'block' factor. The factor activates only when the source value is greater than this value.
threshold.gltf_detailedDescription: Among the standard factors, only 'block' reads this value. On a custom type it has no standard meaning, and only the factor of a supported same-object companion extension MAY read it. Such a factor reads an omitted value as `0`, so omitting it gives the same factor as authoring `0`. Exporters MUST NOT write it when `type` is `blend` or omitted; importers MUST ignore it there.
